acceptance_criteria: Add a QC feedback domain contract for shadow evidence.
Supported feedback types are CONFIRM_BLOCKED, MARK_FALSE_POSITIVE, MARK_FALSE_NEGATIVE, and REQUEST_REVIEW.
Feedback payloads always deny production authority and include production approval blockers.
Feedback can be persisted append-only to the existing qc_feedback audit table for an existing inspection.
Feedback can be fetched by inspection ID.
Add a minimal HTTP JSON endpoint for validating and returning QC feedback shadow evidence.
No product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, production PASS/NG authority, production auto-reject, production deploy, secrets, customer data, or destructive migration changes are introduced.
Existing Flange QC v2 unit/contract tests, product CI, and full repository tests pass.

retrieved_decisions: Product spec approval and QC/SOP tolerance approval remain human gates.
Shadow PASS/NG/BLOCKED evidence cannot grant production authority.
Audit evidence is append-only for bootstrap/replay.
retrieved_lessons: Start each implementation package from a GitHub issue with DoR evidence.
Keep production release/deploy, secrets, customer data, and destructive migrations out of routine automation.
